newsitem.title: USA: Tennessee to sell $197.8 million GO bonds on May 7.
newsitem.headline: Tennessee to sell $197.8 million GO bonds on May 7.

text.p: Tennessee will sell $197.8 million of general obligation bonds by competitive bid on May 7 at 10:30 a.m. EDT, bond finance spokeswoman Mary Margaret Collier said.
The issue includes two series, which will be bid separately. The $172.805 million Series A will fund general improvments to state facilities.
The $25 million Series B will fund part of a grant to the Nashville-Davidson Metropolitan Government for construction of the football stadium where the former Houston Oilers will play.
